tpms.when: 2023–2024 Corolla Cross and Corolla Cross Hybrid, set from Vehicle Settings in the multi-information display
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the vehicle on.
Use the steering wheel switches for the multi-information display to move to the screen that lists Vehicle Settings (the icon differs between the 4.2-inch and 7-inch displays).
Select Vehicle Settings, then press and hold the select switch to open it.
Select TPWS setting and open it.
Select Set Pressure, then press and hold the select switch until a message shows on the display.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2023 and 2024 Corolla Cross Quick Reference Guides.
